key_structures: Puruhutika Devi Sanctum inside Kukkuteswara Swamy complex
Pada Gaya Sarovaram (sacred lotus tank for ancestral rites)
special_features: Four-armed black granite deity holding bag of jewels (ratnapatra), lotus, dish, and posture of boons
Sacred Pada Gaya tank where Vishnu's lotus feet rested after pinning demon Gayasura
Carved stone mandapas showing Chalukyan pillar motifs
renovation_history: Patronized by Eastern Chalukyas of Vengi; damaged in medieval raids and revived by local Zamindars of Pithapuram and Vijayanagara feudatories.
